network_status.summary_it: Il Sologo appartiene al sistema del Cedrino, ma i deflussi ricostruiti alla diga non sono una misura sul Rio Sologo e non vengono assegnati al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The Sologo belongs to the Cedrino system, but reconstructed dam inflow is not a Rio Sologo measurement and is not assigned to the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
